answer.rationale: Memory 44 and memory 57 most directly support sustainable long-term qualified revenue: enterprise sales-assisted flows improved pipeline quality, while referrals added qualified revenue without measurable retention harm. Memory 31 and memory 86 show durable or improved activation and adoption, but omit qualified revenue, retention, and longer-term monetization evidence. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but promotional pricing may be less sustainable and omits retention and revenue quality. Memory 91 is least supported because it only describes improved engagement and first meaningful action, with no direct evidence of qualified revenue, retention, or durability.
